title: Extraneous Calibrations when opening android app
body:
Several times over the past week, extraneous calibration points have been added. It seems that sometimes when I open the app, it grabs my last blood test glucose value (even four hours prior) and then uses that as a new calibration value. I have to do a new finger prick and 'over ride calibration' to not end up with a ludicrous calibration.

I am using the beta update.

comments.body: Please post the version string here. Did you enable auto calibration?

Version: e14bae1-2020.07.13
Code: 2007131533

Yes, 'automatic calibration' has been enabled.

I recently moved from an Xperia Compact Z to a Pixel 4a.  I thought I had it enabled there and didn't see any problems.  This seems to have only shown up in the last couple of weeks (and I've had the Pixel for a month or two).

@joshualamorie 
What is the hardware data source?
Are you still experiencing the issue?
Would the issue persist if you disable automatic calibration?

We can reopen if you are still experiencing this and have time to work with us to resolve it.
